test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1099574319999979e0b07996573e4b0dc50a051d8ca255b4207115080a91d32e.png]
solution:
The rectangle is moving in anti-clockwise direction and as we move along the series, we see the black colored portion of the rectangles shifts one position in each step.

The figure at the centre of the image is rotating in clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a2c8b311274d56e2f330abf43a7768cfb318d849a12c647a4b8caa74819030b.png] 

Hence, '**option 1**' is the correct answer.
